div.div:
Notation
3D box = node («device» or «execution environment»); dashed = «external»
page with corner = «artifact» or «volume»; nesting = allocated-to
thick line = protocol link (label = protocol)
dashed open arrow = «mounts» dependency
frame = group (Compose project)
